endpoints.name: Customers
endpoints.description: The customers on the account, filterable with Fusebill's query syntax. Carries the company or personal name, reference, status, currency, the primary contact and addresses. THE QUERY PARAMETER IS THE FILTERING MODEL throughout this connector -- a field:value expression rather than named parameters -- so most questions are shaped by what that syntax supports.

endpoints.name: Customer Overview
endpoints.description: One customer's headline figures in a single call -- balances, subscription counts and recent activity. Requires a customer id. The efficient summary, as opposed to assembling it from the subscription, invoice and payment tables separately.

endpoints.name: Customer
endpoints.description: One customer by id.

endpoints.name: Customer Email Preferences
endpoints.description: Which billing emails one customer receives. Requires a customer id.

endpoints.name: Customer Billing Settings
endpoints.description: One customer's billing configuration -- payment terms, currency, tax settings and collection behaviour. Requires a customer id. Collection behaviour is what explains an invoice sitting unpaid by design rather than through failure.

endpoints.name: Customer Address Preferences
endpoints.description: The address configuration of one customer -- which address is used for billing, shipping and tax. Requires a customer id. Tax is computed against one of these, so it matters for reconciling a tax figure.

endpoints.name: Customer Ship/Bill Address
endpoints.description: One address by id, with its full detail.

endpoints.name: Countries
endpoints.description: The countries and their subdivisions Fusebill recognises. Reference data, and relevant because tax rules are keyed on them.

endpoints.name: Subscriptions
endpoints.description: Every subscription on the account, filterable by query. Carries the customer, status, activation and cancellation dates, the billing period, and the products attached. The recurring-revenue backbone.

endpoints.name: Subscription Summaries
endpoints.description: A condensed view of subscriptions, filterable by query. Cheaper than the full records when only status and value are wanted.

endpoints.name: Customer Subscriptions
endpoints.description: The subscriptions of one customer. Requires a customer id.

endpoints.name: Subscription
endpoints.description: One subscription by id, with its products and schedule.

endpoints.name: Subscription Count by Status
endpoints.description: How many subscriptions sit in each status. A ready-made aggregate, and the cheapest health check on a recurring-revenue base.

endpoints.name: Subscription Product
endpoints.description: One product on one subscription, with its price, quantity and schedule. What a subscription actually consists of, as opposed to its header.

endpoints.name: Customer Billing Period Definitions
endpoints.description: The billing periods configured for one customer. Requires a customer id. When a customer is billed, which decides which period a charge falls in.

endpoints.name: Subscription Billing Period Definition
endpoints.description: The billing period of one subscription. Requires a subscription id.

endpoints.name: Billing Period Definition Details
endpoints.description: One billing period definition by id, with its start, end and cycle.

endpoints.name: Coupons
endpoints.description: The coupons defined, filterable by query. Campaign-level discounting, as opposed to per-purchase discounts.

endpoints.name: Coupon
endpoints.description: One coupon by id, with its redemption terms.

endpoints.name: Subscription Scheduled Migrations
endpoints.description: The plan changes already scheduled for one subscription. Requires a subscription id. FORWARD-LOOKING: the subscription shows today's plan, so a revenue projection that ignores this misses committed upgrades and downgrades.

endpoints.name: Purchases by Product
endpoints.description: The purchases of one product across customers. Requires a product id. Which customers bought a given item.

endpoints.name: Purchases by Customer
endpoints.description: The one-off purchases of one customer, filterable by query. Requires a customer id. Non-recurring revenue, which the subscription tables do not represent -- a total that counts only subscriptions understates what a customer paid.

endpoints.name: Purchase
endpoints.description: One purchase by id, with its items.

endpoints.name: Purchase Discount
endpoints.description: One discount applied to a purchase, by id.

endpoints.name: Tracked Items
endpoints.description: The item types tracked for quantity-based billing -- seats, users, devices. The unit definitions behind usage counts.

endpoints.name: Subscription Product Items
endpoints.description: The tracked items within one subscription product. Requires a subscription product id. The unit level -- seats, licences, devices -- that quantity-based billing counts.

endpoints.name: Subscription Product Item
endpoints.description: One subscription product item by id.

endpoints.name: Purchase Product Item
endpoints.description: One purchased item by id.

endpoints.name: Related Statuses
endpoints.description: The statuses a subscription product item can hold, by reference. The decoder for an item's status.

endpoints.name: Sales Tracking Code by Type
endpoints.description: The sales tracking codes of one type. Fusebill offers several free-form tracking code slots, which is where an account records campaign, region or rep attribution -- and their meaning is entirely account-specific.

endpoints.name: Sales Tracking Code by Type and Code
endpoints.description: One tracking code by its type and value.

endpoints.name: Payment Details
endpoints.description: One payment by id, with its method, amount and outcome.

endpoints.name: Customer Payment Activities
endpoints.description: The payment activity of one customer. Requires a customer id.

endpoints.name: Payment Activities
endpoints.description: Payment activity across the account, filterable by query. The transaction log: attempts, successes and failures. FAILED PAYMENTS ARE HERE AND NOT ON THE INVOICE, which is where involuntary churn is diagnosed.

endpoints.name: Child Payment Activities
endpoints.description: The payment activity of a customer's child accounts. Requires the parent customer id. Where a parent pays for children, revenue read at the parent alone misattributes it.

endpoints.name: Payment Activity
endpoints.description: One payment activity by id, with its gateway response.

endpoints.name: Refund
endpoints.description: One refund by transaction id.

endpoints.name: Payment Methods
endpoints.description: All payment methods on file for one customer. Requires a customer id.

endpoints.name: Credit Card Payment Methods
endpoints.description: The cards on file for one customer, with expiry and last four digits. Requires a customer id. AN EXPIRING CARD IS THE COMMONEST CAUSE OF INVOLUNTARY CHURN, and the expiry here is the only place it can be anticipated.

endpoints.name: Credit Card Payment Method
endpoints.description: One card payment method by id.

endpoints.name: ACH Payment Methods
endpoints.description: The bank-draft payment methods on file for one customer. Requires a customer id. ACH fails differently from cards -- later and for different reasons -- so the two are worth separating in any failure analysis.

endpoints.name: ACH Payment Method
endpoints.description: One ACH payment method by id.

endpoints.name: AR Activities
endpoints.description: Accounts receivable activity over a date range -- invoices raised, payments received, credits applied. The ledger view of what customers owe and have paid.

endpoints.name: Customer AR Activities
endpoints.description: The receivable activity of one customer. Requires a customer id. The per-account statement.

endpoints.name: Credit
endpoints.description: One credit transaction by id.

endpoints.name: Debit
endpoints.description: One debit transaction by id.

endpoints.name: Credit Note Summaries
endpoints.description: The credit notes issued, filterable by query. Revenue net of credits requires this; invoice totals alone overstate it.

endpoints.name: Credit Note
endpoints.description: One credit note by id.

endpoints.name: Draft Invoice Summaries
endpoints.description: The draft invoices, filterable by query. NOT YET ISSUED -- they represent charges accrued and about to be billed, so they are the forward view that the issued-invoice table cannot give.

endpoints.name: Customer Draft Invoices
endpoints.description: The draft invoices of one customer. Requires a customer id.

endpoints.name: Draft Invoice
endpoints.description: One draft invoice by id, with its lines.

endpoints.name: Invoice Summaries
endpoints.description: A condensed invoice listing, filterable by query. Cheaper for totals and status than the full records.

endpoints.name: Invoices
endpoints.description: The invoices issued, filterable by query. Carries the customer, number, dates, status, totals and line items. Only issued invoices are revenue; drafts are a separate table entirely.

endpoints.name: Customer Invoices
endpoints.description: The invoices of one customer, optionally including zero-dollar ones. Requires a customer id. ZERO-DOLLAR INVOICES ARE EXCLUDED BY DEFAULT, which quietly changes an invoice count -- they are real documents produced by fully discounted or credited subscriptions.

endpoints.name: Invoice
endpoints.description: One invoice by id, with its lines.

endpoints.name: Credit Allocations
endpoints.description: How credits were applied to one invoice. Requires an invoice id. An invoice's balance falls through payment or credit, and only this distinguishes the two.

endpoints.name: Payment Allocations
endpoints.description: How payments were applied to one invoice. Requires an invoice id. The other half of how a balance was settled.

endpoints.name: Charge Summary
endpoints.description: The charges accrued for one customer, filterable by query. Requires a customer id. Accrued rather than billed, which is why it and the invoice total legitimately differ mid-period.

endpoints.name: Plans
endpoints.description: The subscription plans offered, filterable by query. What is sold on a recurring basis.

endpoints.name: Plan
endpoints.description: One plan by id.

endpoints.name: Product Summaries
endpoints.description: A condensed product listing, filterable by query.

endpoints.name: Products
endpoints.description: The product catalogue, optionally with pricing. The individual sellable items plans are built from.

endpoints.name: Product
endpoints.description: One product by id.

endpoints.name: Plan Products by Plan
endpoints.description: The products within one plan, with their prices. Requires a plan id. What a plan actually includes.

endpoints.name: Plan Products by Catalog Product
endpoints.description: The plans one product appears in. Requires a product id. The reverse view -- where a product is sold.

endpoints.name: Plan Product
endpoints.description: One plan product by id.

endpoints.name: Discounts
endpoints.description: The discounts defined, filterable by query. The gap between list price and realised price.

endpoints.name: Discount
endpoints.description: One discount by id.

endpoints.name: Plan Families
endpoints.description: The families plans are grouped into. The catalogue's top level, and the axis that separates product lines.

endpoints.name: Plan Family
endpoints.description: One plan family by id.

endpoints.name: Plan Families by Plan
endpoints.description: The families one plan belongs to. Requires a plan id.

endpoints.name: Plan Families by Subscription
endpoints.description: The families reached through one subscription. Requires a subscription id.

endpoints.name: QuickBooks Online Exchange Rates
endpoints.description: The exchange rates synced from QuickBooks Online. Relevant because Fusebill holds amounts in their own currencies and this is where conversion comes from.

endpoints.name: Net Collections Summary
endpoints.description: Net cash collected in one currency, as a summary. A ready-made figure, and it separates cash from billings, which accrual-based invoice totals conflate.

endpoints.name: Net Earned Revenue Summary
endpoints.description: Net earned revenue in one currency. The accrual counterpart to net collections -- the two answer different questions and diverge exactly by deferred revenue.
